newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start higher after Wall Street surge.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start higher after Wall Street surge.

text.p: UK shares were mostly firmer in the opening minutes of trade on Wednesday, with investors cheered by Wall Street's record finish on Tuesday.
But the Dow's recent volatility, a scarcity of corporate news and fears of higher interest rates are expected to keep many players on the sidelines, dealers said.
"It's a predictable mark up after Wall Street," the head of trading at large investment bank said.
"The spectre of higher interest rates will keep the market on its toes so I wouldn't look for any dramatic gains today."
The FTSE 100 index was up 11.3 at 4,090.1 by 0836 GMT.
